measurementMethod.noseVisualPoint: Rightmost alpha>=128 metal point of the nose within y350..649, with mean y if the extremal x spans several rows.
measurementMethod.rearVisualPoint: Equal mean of the bounding centers of the visible warm-orange regions in the upper and lower main nacelle assemblies. This is a 2D group registration landmark, not the center of a physically inferred hidden nozzle.
measurementMethod.orangePredicate: alpha>=128 and red>150 and green>65 and red-blue>50,4-connected components with>=100pixels in x<600,y150..899. Upper/lower groups split by component center y<500. The shallow-front far-nacelle group additionally excludes the unrelated deck strip at x>=400, explicitly recorded in its components.
measurementMethod.orangeGrouping: Each group unions qualifying orange barrel/cavity surfaces of one main housing. A housing can expose more than one lit surface; no extra main engine count is inferred. Bounds are half-open; centers use(min+maxExclusive−1)/2.
measurementMethod.registeredPoints: Transport unchanged historical nose/tail/pivot/release together by the similarity between the profile visual aft-group-to-nose axis and each selected candidate axis. Preserve the profile offsets; no anisotropic deformation or hidden 3D landmark is introduced.
measurementMethod.precision: Numeric fractions make the chosen source-art measurements reproducible, not a subpixel or rigid3D reconstruction.
measurementMethod.pivot: Registration pivot derived from the profile full-canvas center; not a physical center of mass.
measurementMethod.release: Derived from unchanged release(1000,580); not a new bay or launch point. Active release/contact retains the established profile.
measurementMethod.aspect: Native candidate1536×1024 versus profile1672×941. The runtime matrix must compensate canvas aspect before rotation/uniform scale; no raster stretching, padding or resizing was performed.
measurementMethod.engines: All separate exhaustVisibility values remain0 and exhaustReview unreviewed. No blue/orange main or secondary emission socket is approved by this measurement.

preserved: Dark armored arrowhead body, narrow nose pointing right, broad aft at left.
Two outer orange main nacelle assemblies and one axial blue main engine, with angle-dependent occlusion.
Small blue-lit maneuvering mounts and red vents/lights consistent with the master family.
remainingDrift: The original profile is explicitly an authored perspective. Its large blue focus is projected toward center-right, whereas the top and many variants place the axial assembly at the aft-left. These images do not establish a single rigid camera-calibrated3D hull.

The final front views are much thinner than the perspective profile; this is retained as a real pose difference and must be inspected during native cross-fades. It is not compensated by anisotropic scaling.
Panels, red lines, small maneuvering-unit placement and highlight levels vary between generated projections.

Ventral-shallow has only a7px minimum alpha>16 margin and eleven left-edge alpha2..3 pixels. Its bright hull is not cropped, but native edge appearance should be checked. No pixel cleanup or padding was applied.

alphaReview.interpretation: All 48 declared off-hull samples have alpha0. Other borders retain low-alpha residue: maximum3 in ventral-shallow, maximum1 elsewhere. Nonzero RGB under alpha0 is hidden under proper compositing; no cleanup or opacity normalization was performed. The initial point(768,250) on rear-deep was found to lie on its actual upper maneuvering unit and is recorded separately, not treated as background.
alphaReview.borderAbove1Finding: Eleven left-edge pixels at x0,y343..353 of bank-ventral-shallow have alpha2..3. Its alpha>16 silhouette starts at x7, so the brighter hull is still inside. This low-alpha residue is preserved; it is not described as a completely empty edge.
